global: Esc / Backspace: go back (or close a window)
Tab: move between buttons · Enter / Space: press
M: MY MISSION · H or ?: this help · ☰: settings

ReviewIntroScene.title: REVIEW YOUR MISSION
ReviewIntroScene.what: The game looked at your real scores by category and picked the concepts you struggled with. Each one shows why it was picked. Next you choose HOW to review them.

ReviewFormatScene.title: CHOOSE YOUR FORMAT
ReviewFormatScene.what: Pick Visual, Podcast, Flashcards, Questions or Text. The concepts are the same in every format; you can switch any time with the tabs.

ReviewScene.title: LEARNING REVIEW
ReviewScene.what: Review each concept in your format. The tabs on top switch format without losing your place.

ReviewCheckScene.title: RETENTION CHECK
ReviewCheckScene.what: Three questions, the same for every format. They show how much you remember.

ReviewResultsScene.title: REVIEW RESULTS
ReviewResultsScene.what: How many check questions you remembered, your format, the time and how the weakness of each concept changed.

ReviewReportScene.title: YOUR REVIEW (REPORT)
ReviewReportScene.what: The report page with your learning review: categories, the concepts picked and why, format, time, check answers and progress.

default.title: HELP
default.what: Follow the mentor's instructions. You can always go back with ◀ BACK.

TitleScene.title: TITLE
TitleScene.what: Choose 1 PLAYER or 4 PLAYERS, then press START. If you have a saved mission, CONTINUE takes you back to it. ☰ opens the settings (narration, text size, volume, reduce motion).

RoleScene.title: CHOOSE YOUR ASTRONAUT
RoleScene.what: Click an astronaut to pick it (yellow border). Click "(i) info" to read what the role does and its bonus. Then press CONFIRM. In 4 PLAYERS mode, each player picks a different role.

StoryScene.title: STORY
StoryScene.what: Read (or listen to) the story. NEXT goes to the next slide; SKIP jumps to choosing your destination.

DestinationScene.title: CHOOSE YOUR DESTINATION
DestinationScene.what: Click a planet to learn about it. Only Mars is open in level 1. In the Mars panel, press DESIGN MISSION.

NextUpScene.title: NEXT UP
NextUpScene.what: A short introduction to the next part of your mission. Press NEXT when you are ready.

ObjectiveScene.title: MISSION OBJECTIVE
ObjectiveScene.what: Use the arrows to see the 3 objectives. Only HUNT FOR ANCIENT WATER is open now. Select it, then press NEXT.

SummaryScene.title: MISSION SUMMARY
SummaryScene.what: Check your choices. Use "✎ change" to go back to any of them. CONTINUE goes to the spacecraft briefing.

BriefingScene.title: BUILD BRIEFING
BriefingScene.what: The mentor explains the workshop in 3 slides: the 5 stations, the meters and Earth responsibility.

WorkshopScene.title: WORKSHOP
WorkshopScene.what: Walk to the numbered stations IN ORDER (1 → 5) and press E to choose each part. Each card shows options A, B (the real MER part) and C. Watch BUDGET, MASS and ENERGY. When all 5 are done, follow the pink path to the warehouse door.
controls: E: use station · Q: ask the mentor

StationScene.title: STATION CARD
StationScene.what: Compare options A, B and C with ◀ ▶ (or the tabs). B is the real MER configuration. INSTALL puts the part on your spacecraft. Values are simulated game values.

WarehouseScene.title: WAREHOUSE
WarehouseScene.what: Walk to the instrument tables and press E to inspect them. Read each card, answer its quick question and add the tools you want to your kit. The exit opens when you have inspected at least one instrument for each of the 5 science requirements.
controls: Click a table: walk there and open it

InstrumentScene.title: INSTRUMENT CARD
InstrumentScene.what: Read what the instrument does, where it mounts and if it is compatible with this rover. ? QUESTION asks one quick question: answer it to mark the table as inspected. ADD TO KIT packs it (it uses budget, mass and energy). ASSEMBLE opens when every requirement has an inspected instrument.
controls: P: add to / remove from kit · Q: question

AssemblyScene.title: BUILD YOUR ROVER
AssemblyScene.what: Drag instruments from the bottom tray onto the rover: mast, body, arm turret (4) and deck (2). Try to cover the 5 science requirements. Some tools only fit on the arm. There is no time limit.
controls: Mouse: drag & drop (or click a tool, then click a spot)

AssemblyResultsScene.title: ASSEMBLY RESULTS
AssemblyResultsScene.what: See how much science your rover can do, how close it is to the real rovers, and whether the parts work together. REBUILD to try again or NEXT to continue.

OrbitScene.title: PLAN YOUR ORBIT
OrbitScene.what: First draw your guess of the path. Then choose the LAUNCH DATE, the TRAVEL TIME and your CRITERION. The game calculates the transfer trajectory (Lambert's problem) with real Earth and Mars data from JPL Horizons and shows the delta-v it needs. Press ENGAGE when you like it.

LaunchReadyScene.title: READY FOR LAUNCH
LaunchReadyScene.what: Read how a launch works, then press LAUNCH!

MeteorScene.title: LAUNCH MINI-GAME
MeteorScene.what: Move the blue shield with the mouse or WASD to push falling rocks away from the rocket. Reach 200 km. With 3 hits you can retry or continue: this game is just for fun and does not change your score. (Interactive game: not a real event.)

SlidesScene.title: REAL MISSION
SlidesScene.what: Read each card about the real Spirit and Opportunity mission. NEXT / BACK move between cards. At the end there is one question.

QuizGateScene.title: QUICK CHECK
QuizGateScene.what: Answer the question correctly to continue. If you miss, you get a short explanation and an easier question. No points are lost.

RockHunterScene.title: ROCK HUNTER
RockHunterScene.what: Drive the rover, stop next to a rock and scan it. Read the clue and COLLECT the rocks with strong water evidence. Collect 3 samples before energy or time runs out.
controls: Space: scan · E: collect · Q: skip

CommsScene.title: COMMS PLANNER
CommsScene.what: Plan how to send your data home: 1) the route, 2) the contact window, 3) the order of the data. Then see your results.
controls: Priority: drag :: or ↑↓ select + W/S move

TalkScene.title: TALKING TO EARTH
TalkScene.what: See how data travels from Mars to Earth: light delay, relay orbiters and the Deep Space Network.

SignalRunScene.title: SIGNAL RUN
SignalRunScene.what: Aim the antenna and press SPACE only while the orbiter is inside the green LINK WINDOW. Dust clouds block packets. Land 3 packets. A packet that misses is NOT lost: it goes back to the rover's memory and you can send it again, like on the real rovers. When the orbiter leaves, wait for the next pass. (Simplified game.)

DashboardScene.title: MISSION DASHBOARD
DashboardScene.what: Your final results. Click a stage card (1–6) to compare your decisions with the real MER mission. LOG shows your mission log. CONTINUE ends the mission.

StageDetailScene.title: YOU vs REAL MISSION
StageDetailScene.what: Each row compares what you decided with what the real MER team did: MATCH, CLOSE or DIFFERENT. Simulated values have no badge.
controls: 1–6: jump to a stage · Esc: dashboard
